mathematical_contract.direction: U maps full fitting/reporting theta to full internal theta; all sample divisors are fixed, not differentiated parameters.
mathematical_contract.response: internal_y=fit_y/r; generated AR/HAR columns inherit r.
mathematical_contract.exogenous: internal_x_j=x_j/d_j; b_internal_j=b_fit_j*d_j/r. No response-density Jacobian from design divisors.
mathematical_contract.public_scale: scale=s remains separate and belongs to the sample adapter: fit_y=s*original_y, original histories receive s or s^2 before internal conversion. Reported values stay in fitting units.
mathematical_contract.variance: Constant innovation variance, GARCH omega and GJR omega divide by r^2.
mathematical_contract.aparch: omega_internal=omega_fit*exp(-delta*log(r)); delta unchanged. Exact omega/delta mixed and delta/delta curvature retained from original fitting theta.
mathematical_contract.egarch: omega_internal=omega_fit-2*log(r)*(1-sum(beta)); omega/beta Jacobian coupling is 2*log(r), map curvature is zero.
mathematical_contract.unchanged: AR/HAR/MA coefficients, other volatility coefficients, delta and standardized density shapes have identity units.
mathematical_contract.hessian: H_fit=J' H_internal J+sum_i G_internal[i]*H(U_i), every dense cross block preserved.
mathematical_contract.internal_h_dependency: A public H-containing mask adds internal G only for nonidentity APARCH response units; the public unrequested gradient is untouched.
mathematical_contract.state_intentions: Response/residual histories divide by r; variance by r^2; APARCH power state by r^delta; EGARCH log variance subtracts 2*log(r). Inverse value intentions restore fitting units.
mathematical_contract.original_chart: No original-z integration here. Chief must resolve chart direction, retain original z and compose both curvatures.
mathematical_contract.model_domain: Map validity is not model feasibility or differentiability certification. Existing model domain owns persistence, variance positivity and density restrictions; map power coordinates require finite positive delta.

memory_contract.layout: One checked constexpr make_layout(LayoutSpec) for runtime and FixedLayout<Spec>; role metadata binds existing model layouts, not another parameter-order builder.
memory_contract.metadata: Plan and PreparedPoint have read-only accessors. Divisor storage and prepared caller arenas require immutable/exclusive lifetime leases.
memory_contract.value_preparation: N internal-theta doubles only; no first/second cache constructed or downgraded.
memory_contract.derivative_preparation: N long-double diagonal entries through WorkspaceArena; sparse coupling scalars, with curvature fields only in PreparedPoint<2>. APARCH factor reused across value and derivative consumers.
memory_contract.allocation: No runtime heap, dynamic stack arrays, dense Jacobian or map Hessian tensor.
memory_contract.admission: Checked counts, capacities, alignment, address extents and overlap before output/scratch writes.
memory_contract.failure: After admission, prepare clears trial validity. A failed trial cannot reuse an old valid marker. Compatible lower-order caches require distinct caller arena slots. Pullback admission failures leave outputs unchanged; numerical failures may modify requested prefixes, with invalid bits unavailable.
memory_contract.unrequested: All provided output ranges participate in alias admission. Unrequested numerical outputs are never written.

numerical_contract.padding: No clipping, variance floor, density padding or persistence margin.
numerical_contract.value_range: Nonfinite results or nonzero outputs that round to zero return numerical_range. APARCH value fallback combines logarithms before exponentiation when the isolated multiplier loses range.
numerical_contract.cache_range: First/second requests require nonzero finite cached slopes in platform long double. Nonzero power couplings or curvature lost to cache underflow fail explicitly rather than become zeros. Wider cache range is not presumed on platforms where long double equals double.
numerical_contract.contraction: Shared scaled products when factors are exactly binary64-representable; otherwise platform long-double products and final binary64 narrowing. Cancellation and extreme-range qualification remain pending.
numerical_contract.shared_arithmetic: No new DD, Quad or compensated-exponent engine. Profile worker's facade request is left to chief coordination, not duplicated here.
